chunks: And from one of his sermons (peace be upon him), in which is an explanation of the causes that destroy people.
ai.seo_question: What are the causes of destruction for people according to Imam Ali's sermons?
ai.summary: In this sermon from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) diagnoses the root causes of societal decay, emphasizing how internal moral corruption and deviation from divine justice lead to collective ruin. This analysis is central to Shia political theology, illustrating the transition from the ideal community to fractured factions through the lens of ethical failure and loss of *haqq* (truth/right).
